name: gradtrack-graduate-presentation
description: Regenerable GradTrack graduate/alumni video presentation using captures of the current application UI.

scripts.studio: npm run sync && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run sync && remotion render src/index.ts GradTrackGraduatePresentation gradtrack-graduate-presentation.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --audio-bitrate=192k --overwrite
scripts.render:preview: npm run sync && remotion render src/index.ts GradTrackGraduatePresentation output/preview.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=26 --pixel-format=yuv420p --audio-codec=aac --scale=0.5 --overwrite
scripts.still: npm run sync && remotion still src/index.ts GradTrackGraduatePresentation output/preview.png --frame=2550 --overwrite
